name: Jamie Raskin

lean.basis: Progressive Democratic Maryland state senator and congressman since 2017; endorsed by Our Revolution in 2016.

current_role: U.S. representative for Maryland's 8th district (since 2017); ranking Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee (since December 2024)
summary: Jamie Raskin, a former constitutional law professor, has represented Maryland's 8th district since 2017. He was the lead House manager in Trump's second impeachment trial (2021), served on the January 6 select committee, and has been the ranking Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee since December 2024.

timeline.role: Lead House manager in Trump's second impeachment trial

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Raskin was the primary author of the impeachment article after January 6, 2021 and the lead manager in Trump's second impeachment trial; he also served on the January 6 select committee.

connections.name: Nancy Pelosi
connections.description: Pelosi named Raskin to the January 6 select committee and lead manager of Trump's second impeachment in January 2021.

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Biden pre-emptively pardoned the members of the January 6 select committee, including Raskin, on January 20, 2025.

connections.name: Elizabeth Warren
connections.description: Warren campaigned with Raskin in his 2016 House race.

connections.name: Jerry Nadler
connections.description: Raskin challenged Nadler for the top Democratic post on the Judiciary Committee in 2024; Nadler withdrew and endorsed him.
